sourceNotes: AI 用量支持自选刷新间隔、已用或剩余额度，以及中文万/亿或 K/M/B 数字单位
新增美元/人民币费用估算，按公开 API 基础单价计算，不含阶梯加价，非订阅账单
Codex 额度新增套餐标签、有效期进度、可用重置卡和最早到期时间，仅作只读展示
AI 用量新增小时与每日柱状图，支持今天、最近 7 天、最近 30 天和累计
改善按钮与分段选项的按压、键盘反馈和文字对比度，优化紧凑布局并适配减少动态效果
在线更新改用新的区域入口，连接失败时自动切换备用线路
为支持小时图，升级后的首次刷新会重新统计本地日志，后续仍采用增量读取
修复累计摘要与图表统计范围不一致的问题，摘要、费用与模型排行统一跟随所选时间范围
修复英文界面的累计选项仍显示中文的问题，补齐 AI 用量译文并改善长文案和从右到左布局

en: Choose the AI usage refresh interval, used or remaining quota display, and Chinese or K/M/B number units
Estimate token costs in USD or CNY using public base API prices, excluding tiered surcharges; these estimates are not subscription bills
Show the Codex plan, validity progress, available reset credits and their earliest expiry as read-only information
View hourly usage for today and daily usage for the last 7 or 30 days; menu bar popovers offer these three periods, while the main window retains the annual activity heatmap
Improve button and segmented-control press and keyboard feedback, text contrast, compact layouts, and Reduce Motion support
Use the new regional update endpoints and automatically try fallback routes when a connection fails
The first refresh after upgrading rebuilds local hourly usage statistics and may take longer; subsequent refreshes continue to read changes incrementally
Keep cumulative summaries, cost estimates, model rankings and charts aligned with the selected time range
Fix the Cumulative option remaining in Chinese in the English interface, complete AI usage translations, and improve long text and right-to-left layouts
